mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and fluid/electrolyte depletion may be exacerbated by medroxyprogesterone's potential sodium retention effects, and medroxyprogesterone may increase thromboembolic risk in patients on diuretics.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (especially potassium), blood pressure, and signs of fluid retention; consider potassium supplementation if needed and assess thromboembolic risk periodically.
